title: Judge dismisses publishers' antitrust suits over Google AI Overviews
summary: Judge Amit Mehta dismissed Chegg and Penske Media antitrust suits over Google's AI Overviews, ruling that 'an expectation is not an agreement'.
reason: Court declines to check a dominant platform's AI product.

title: Apple tightens macOS Full Disk Access citing AI-agent privacy risks
summary: Apple said it is tightening macOS Full Disk Access controls because of new risks from AI agents overreaching into private data.
reason: Platform-level privacy protection against agent data collection.
